verdict.rationale: Intel markets Copilot+ voice-assistant integration and NPU-accelerated AI features as capabilities enabled by the Core Ultra 258V (docs-7, docs-15, docs-22), but the chip itself is hardware, not an assistant—the assistant is Windows Copilot+ running atop it, and there's no evidence of a delegate-task interface built into the processor itself. missing for 10: first-party evidence of an actual in-product assistant UI/agent (vs. just enabling OS-level Copilot+), independent hands-on validation of task delegation.
